overloads.semanticRole: The Is license available command lets you find out the availability of a plug-in.

constraints: license can be passed three ways: omitted (returns False only when the whole 4D application is in demonstration mode); one of the '"Is License Available" theme' plug-in constants (e.g. 4D Client SOAP license = 808465465, 4D Client Web license = 808465209, 4D for OCI license = 808465208, 4D ODBC Pro license = 808464946, 4D REST Test license = 808465719, 4D SOAP license = 808465464, 4D View license = 808465207, 4D Web license = 808464945, 4D Write license = 808464697); or a raw plug-in "4BNX" resource ID number.
Takes into account licenses attributed in Design mode or via SET PLUGIN ACCESS; returns False if the plug-in is operating in demo mode.
